benchmark.timing: wall-clock update + JS-thread recording (including synchronous JSI/native work) + synchronous offscreen GPU flush(true); not presented FPS

limitations: One sequential trial per fixture/platform; workload order fixed and desktop load uncontrolled. Differences near timing noise are not established improvements.
iOS uses Mac Metal and Android uses a CPU Vulkan driver. These are not physical phone GPU or thermal/power measurements.
Picture replays native operations and may retain native resources; one adapter draw is not one GPU draw call.
Keep historical live-Spine and shared-cache workload identities and distributions unchanged.
